name: sonner
title: Sonner Toaster
blurb: Sonner Toaster wrapper with theme support and custom styling.
description: Wrapper component around Sonner's Toaster with useTheme integration, CSS custom properties for styling, and toastOptions for description styling.
use_when: You need to add the Sonner toast system to your app with theme-aware styling.
avoid_when: If using a different toast library; this is Sonner-specific.
a11y: Toaster handles accessibility; respects prefers-reduced-motion when Sonner is configured.
